161.long_description: Transform your arcade game experience with Arcooda’s 16.6″ LCD Marquee monitors, crafted for Game Wizard Xtreme, Viewlix, and Chewlix cabinets, this plug‑and‑play digital display offers stunning visuals with full viewing angles for the best gaming displays. Vivid, Wide-Angle Visuals That Come Alive Feed your arcade world with over 16.7 million colors and enjoy the widest 89° viewing angles in all directions. This means vibrant, crystal-clear artwork, animations, or score displays—from every corner of the room. Versatility Beyond the Arcade Not just for gaming, this versatile marquee LCD display works perfectly in home entertainment, AV setups, public info kiosks, and more. It’s a flexible, high-performance screen that adapts to your creative needs. Play videos, display multiple images and create your own play lists. Its perfect for digital displays over doors, in venues, or point of sale locations. Multiple Media Options: Display Your Way Want to show game headers, player instructions, animations, or ads on our marquee arcade lcd monitor? No problem. Connect via HDMI or VGA, or load content onto a USB stick to play static images or video loops. Supported formats include MOV H.264, MPEG, and more, making your display smart and stylish. Firmware That Keeps You Future-Proof The latest version firmware is V10, with expanded aspect ratio options, language support, screen-flip settings, and improved input handling (blank screen when idle, instead of a “no signal” display). If you own the previous version our our 16.6inch marquee LCD monitor, Arcooda offers a free firmware update to stay on the cutting edge. Our 16.6inch marquee arcade LCD monitor can be found here.
